description: Source file implementing an Android Activity demonstrating fragment participation in the options menu, including handling fragment creation, menu creation, and visibility toggling via checkboxes.

classes.name: FragmentMenu
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating fragment options menu participation and visibility toggling.

classes.name: FragmentMenu.MenuFragment
classes.description: A fragment with menu items; does not implement a UI but adds menu options.

classes.name: FragmentMenu.Menu2Fragment
classes.description: A second fragment with menu options; also does not have a UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, creates and adds fragments if absent, and sets up checkboxes and their listeners.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Ensures fragment visibility state is updated after activity state restoration.

methods.name: updateFragmentVisibility
methods.description: Updates fragment visibility based on the checkboxes' checked states.

methods.name: MenuFragment.onCreate
methods.description: Prepares the menu fragment, indicating it has options menu.

methods.name: MenuFragment.onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates menu items for the first fragment.

methods.name: Menu2Fragment.onCreate
methods.description: Prepares the second menu fragment for options menu creation.

methods.name: Menu2Fragment.onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates menu items for the second fragment.
